title: Enable Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
description: Multi-factor authentication adds an extra defensive layer. Even if your password is leaked, attackers cannot access your account without the second factor (e.g., authenticator app or hardware key).

title: Practice the 3-2-1 Backup Strategy
description: Keep at least 3 copies of your important data: on 2 different media formats (e.g., internal drive and external SSD), with at least 1 copy kept off-site or in secure cloud storage.

title: Inspect URL Links Before Clicking
description: Hover over hyperlinks to verify the actual destination URL. Attackers frequently use typosquatting domains like 'arnazon.com' or 'paypa1.com' to trick victims.

title: Never Reuse Passwords Across Websites
description: When a minor website suffers a credential breach, hackers attempt credential stuffing on banking, email, and social media accounts. Use a reputable password manager.

title: Keep Operating Systems & Firmware Patched
description: Security patches fix known vulnerabilities (CVEs) that attackers actively exploit. Turn on automatic security updates for your OS, browser, and home router.
